source_theorem.statement: For each of the two maximal A5 classes, an exact nonzero degree-11 A5-equivariant covariant P2 --> X lands identically on the restricted Klein cubic.

bridge.lemma: A nonempty A5-equivariant rational map from the projectivization of a linear representation to X makes every A5 twist of X soluble over every infinite extension field containing C.
bridge.domain_twist: The twist of the source three-space is a three-dimensional vector space by linear descent, so its projectivization is P2 and its rational points meet every nonempty open.
bridge.application: For a generic G-torsor E/K and L=E^A5, the base change of the full twist to L is the A5 twist by E/L and therefore has an L-point.
bridge.closed_point_dichotomy: The resulting point has residue degree 1 or 11 over K because [L:K]=11 is prime.

scope.proved: The genuine generic Schur twist has an effective zero-cycle of degree 11; equivalently it has a K-point or a degree-11 closed point.
scope.not_proved: No K-rational point is constructed and no functorial pointlessness obstruction is obtained.
